Toy tip data of three species attributes

Source: R/dataset_doc.R
toy_tip_data.Rd

States of three species attributes for the 30 tips of phylograftR::toy_backbone: a color, an elevation and a biogeographic range. They are the tip data from which stochastic maps are inferred in vignette("prepare_stochastic_maps") (see phylograftR::toy_multiSimmap, phylograftR::toy_multiSimmap_elevation and phylograftR::toy_multiSimmap_ranges).

They are the states found at the tips of phylograftR::toy_simmap, phylograftR::toy_simmap_elevation and phylograftR::toy_simmap_ranges, so the datasets are consistent with all the other toy datasets.

Usage

data(toy_tip_data)

Format

A data.frame with 30 rows (the tips of phylograftR::toy_backbone, as row names and in the same order) and three character columns:

  • $color: "blue", "green" or "red".

  • $elevation: "high" or "low".

  • $range: biogeographic ranges coded as in BioGeoBEARS, i.e., "A", "B", "AB" or "BC".

See also

Other datasets and functions from phylograftR:

  • phylograftR::toy_multiSimmap, phylograftR::toy_multiSimmap_elevation and phylograftR::toy_multiSimmap_ranges for the stochastic maps inferred from these data.

  • phylograftR::toy_backbone for the backbone phylogeny.

Examples

# Import the data
data(toy_tip_data)
head(toy_tip_data)
#>     color elevation range
#> t26  blue       low     B
#> t2   blue      high    AB
#> t21  blue      high    AB
#> t16 green      high    AB
#> t11  blue       low     A
#> t4   blue       low     A

# Named vector of tip states of one attribute, as required by deepSTRAPP::prepare_trait_data()
tip_colors <- setNames(toy_tip_data$color, row.names(toy_tip_data))
table(tip_colors)
#> tip_colors
#>  blue green   red 
#>    11    11     8
